name: Field formatter
description: Collection of general formatters that display a single field from the referenced entity.
project_description:
Field Formatter module provides a collection of generic formatters for entity reference fields that output only a specific field of the referenced entity.

 Back to top 

 Formatters for entity reference fields: 
 Field formatter with inline settings (field_formatter_with_inline_settings) 
 Configure the field formatter individually to render one field of the referenced entity selectively with the same settings available like in its own entity.

 Usage example: Configure your field display of a single field completely individually in a referencing entity display.

 Field formatter from view display (field_formatter_from_view_display) 
 Display one field from the referenced entity exactly like it is configured in its own entity display mode, which is selectable.

 Usage example: Configure your field display for example in media entities and reuse single fields in referencing entities.

 Field linker (field_link) 
 Link field formatter, which will wrap output of any other formatter with a link to the parent entity. Field linker is available for all field types, not just entity reference fields.

 Usage example: Field linker formatter is for example helpful in teaser view modes to link to the full display.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Download [Field Formatter]( https://www.drupal.org/project/field_formatter ) from [Drupal.org]( https://www.drupal.org/node/2328797/release ). 
 Install it in the usual way .
